description.en: The built-in workspace list, rebuilt on cmux-extension-sdk: every workspace in your order, the one you are in selected, and how many chats wait for you in each. Copy the folder and change it; name it in sidebar.workspaceListApp to draw it in place of the built-in list.

scopes.workspace:read: List your workspaces and hear when one changes.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a workspace when you click its row.
scopes.agent_chat:read: Count the chats waiting for your answer.
